title: Fastlane PRD: compact hosted endpoints (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank) — scope clarifications & launch rundown
creator: Priya Singh
description: Summary: This PRD defines a compact, developer-focused hosted endpoint bundle ("fastlane") that exposes a unified surface for chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank in a constrained first-phase scope. Goal: enable a low-friction launch that meets predictable latency and cost targets while keeping operational complexity manageable for the first wave of customers. The doc clarifies behavior, hard/soft scope limits, acceptance criteria, and a concrete launch rundown (canary -> staged rollout -> full), including telemetry, monitoring, and rollback criteria.
scope_changes: Initial scope (v1): chat, completions, embeddings, rerank basic modes; JSON/structured output optional but not required; streaming disabled for v1. Scope removed from v1: multimodal payloads, long-context (>16k) support, per-request custom kernel overrides, multi-tenant dedicated auto-burst capacity. Rationale: trim shipping surface to minimize runtime/kernel permutations and reduce QA surface area. We will track these as phased enhancements for v1.1+.
requirements_clarifications:
- API surface: single endpoint family /v1/fastlane with parameterized mode (mode=chat|complete|embed|rerank).
- Behavioral contracts: deterministic tokenization for embeddings, stable top-1 quality for rerank within ±2% of baseline model.
- Latency SLOs: p50 <= 60ms for embeddings small-vec (<=512 tokens), p95 <= 400ms for chat short-turn (<=512 tokens).
- Authentication/quotas: standard API key; team-level quotas enabled.
- Data handling: requests logged for observability; persistent KV caching allowed only for inference runtime (no customer KV storage).
- Streaming: deferred to v1.1; return full response JSON in single payload for now.
- Error model: standardized error codes (400/401/403/429/500) plus a structured error body with error_code and guidance field.
acceptance_criteria:
- Functional: All 4 modes respond correctly for canonical prompt set (see /docs/fastlane/evals).
- Performance: Measured against synthetic traffic with target SLOs above; p95 stability over a 24h test window.
- Cost: Per-token median cost within 15% of dedicated baseline for the same model family.
- Observability: Per-route dashboards in Console with token-level cost, latency, error breakdowns, and 30-day retention in staging.
- Rollout safety: Canary slice (1% of traffic) must show no >5% increase in 5xxs or >10% latency regression vs baseline during 48h.
- Security/Compliance: KMS-integrated secret handling for keys in Private deployments; security review passed and signed off.
- Docs/SDKs: Quickstart examples in Python and JS, plus an SDK patch release, published and smoke-tested.
- E2E tests: Conformance harness with determinism checks and non-regression tests green on main.
- Rollback: Automated route-level rollback works and has been exercised once in staging.
launch_checklist: Finalize API spec and OpenAPI doc and publish to portal
Consolidate canonical eval prompt sets and publish baseline scores
QA: run 72h soak with mixed-mode traffic (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
Console: create per-route dashboards and alerting (latency, errors, token spend)
Release SDKs (Python, JS) and run quickstart smoke tests
Security: complete security review, KMS validation, and add audit log hooks
Infra: capacity verification and autoscaling policy for fastlane routes
Canary: configure 1% traffic slice + monitoring playbook
Run canary for 48h and validate rollout safety gates
Post-launch: schedule 72h hypercare rotation and on-call escalation matrix
Docs: publish migration notes and behavioral contract section
Billing: ensure rate-limits and quotas connected to billing pipeline
Support: prepare KB articles and troubleshooting runbook
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal preview (internal Redwood teams and selected partners). Phase 1 (Canary): 1% external traffic for 48h; hold for 72h observation. Phase 2 (Staged): 10% -> 30% -> 100% over five days if metrics stable. Blockers at any gate: revert to previous route, open incident, and pause rollout. Communication: daily rollout digest to stakeholders and '#fastlane-ship' Slack channel.
metrics_and_slos:
- Latency: embeddings p50<=35ms p95<=120ms (<=512 tokens); chat p50<=120ms p95<=400ms.
- Reliability: error rate (5xx) < 0.1% steady-state.
- Quality: rerank NDCG@10 degradation <= 2% vs baseline; completions semantic similarity >0.85 on test set.
- Cost: per-token spend tracked; alert if per-route cost increases >20% over baseline.
- Ops: Mean Time To Detect (MTTD) < 5m for 5xx surge; MTTI (investigation) <30m for critical incidents.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Model quality regression during quantization or kernel swap. Mitigation: block rollout if quality drift >2% on holdout prompts; maintain fallback to verified model variant.
- Risk: Unexpected latency regression at p95. Mitigation: automatic routing to lower-latency compatible variant and temporary scaling.
- Risk: Billing spike. Mitigation: per-tenant quota safeguards and emergency rate-limiter.
- Risk: Missing observability gaps. Mitigation: dry-run telemetry pipeline and simulated drops prior to canary.
- Risk: Security sign-off delay. Mitigation: parallelize security reviews and include a frozen cut for features that require long lead.
testing_plan:
- Unit + integration tests for API surface and SDKs.
- Conformance harness: run determinism and behavioral tests for canonical prompts.
- Load tests: run mixed-mode 1000rps for 2h and analyze tail latencies.
- Soak tests: 72h continuous traffic for stability.
- Chaos tests: introduce pod evictions and kernel fallback to validate graceful degradation.
- Manual: UX runbook for support engineers to reproduce customer-facing errors.
notes_and_decisions: Decision: single endpoint family chosen to reduce client integration overhead (2025-01-17)
Decision: disable streaming in v1 to keep runtime surface stable; track streaming as v1.1 feature (2025-01-22)
Clarification: rerank will accept batched query pairs and return scored list; top-K parameter default set to 10 (2025-02-02)
Trade-off: limiting context to 16k for v1 to simplify kernel selection, accept future extension work for long-context models
